title: Enhancing Smart Grid Security: A Deep Learning Approach to Adversarial Intrusion Detection
summary: A research codebase for an intrusion detection system (IDS) on smart-grid network traffic (DNP3 protocol), covering PCAP-to-image conversion, tabular and image-based classifier training, and adversarial attack generation/evaluation. To handle class imbalance among attack labels, trainers/ctgan_trainer.py fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer per label on tabular flow features and evaluates the synthetic output with SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic.
evidence: trainers/ctgan_trainer.py: CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, verbose=True, epochs=100, embedding_dim=32) plus run_diagnostic/evaluate_quality calls
